## 问题与结果 / Problem and resulting behavior

说明具体触发场景、修改前后行为以及受影响规范规则；文档变更说明帮助读者解决什么歧义。
Describe the trigger, before/after behavior and affected rules, or the ambiguity resolved for readers.

## 兼容性与范围 / Compatibility and scope

核心/扩展/实现/文档；是否改变接受消息集合、错误码或状态；如破坏兼容附版本与迁移说明。
Core/extension/implementation/documentation; changes to accepted messages, errors or state; version and migration notes if breaking.

## 实际验证 / Actual validation

运行命令、环境、真实输出或报告路径；未执行及原因。不要把预期结果写成已通过。
Commands, environment, actual output/report paths and unexecuted checks with reasons. Do not report expected results as executed passes.

## 审核清单 / Review checklist

- [ ] 保留需求优先、角色中立、交易分离、开放和免费协议原则 / Core principles preserved.
- [ ] 规范、Schema、公开向量与实现保持一致，或明确列出未解决差异 / Artifacts agree or unresolved differences are identified.
- [ ] 核心变更链接公开问题/RFC及兼容性分析 / Core changes link discussion/RFC and compatibility analysis.
- [ ] 未提交私人数据、凭据、敏感日志或未获许可的来源 / No private data, credentials, sensitive logs or unauthorized material.
- [ ] 已披露第三方来源、许可与 AI 辅助范围 / Third-party provenance, licenses and AI assistance are disclosed.
- [ ] 模拟结果、独立实现结果与真实网络安全结论分别声明 / Synthetic, independent-implementation and network-security claims are separated.

## 仍需决定的问题 / Remaining decisions

尚未验证的风险、争议及审阅者需要的证据：
Unverified risks, disagreements and evidence reviewers need:
